title: The effect of portable air purifiers and cabin air filters on particulate matter and nitrogen oxides concentrations in vehicle cabins
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,3029-3037
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00194C, Paper
Evan Renck, Heejung Jung
Portable air purifiers and adsorption-type cabin filters were tested inside vehicles to assess their ability to reduce PM and NO2. The filter size and flow rate strongly influenced the removal efficiency, especially at different HVAC fan speeds.
